ENGLISH: The Far Country
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 远方

ENGLISH: The Prodigal Son
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 浪子回头

ENGLISH: A son asks for his inheritance early. His father gives it — and then waits by the road.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 两个儿子，一个父亲。一个离家，一个留下；父亲却为两个人都跑了出去。

ENGLISH: c. AD 30, in Galilee. Jesus is answering religious leaders who complain that he welcomes the wrong people, and he tells three stories in a row about something lost: a sheep, a coin, a son.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 约公元 30 年，加利利。耶稣正在回答宗教领袖的抱怨——他们怪他接待不该接待的人。他一连讲了三个「失而复得」的故事：一只羊、一块钱、一个儿子。

ENGLISH: A father and two sons. The younger asks for his inheritance now — in that culture, the same as saying “I wish you were dead”. The elder stays, works, and keeps every rule.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 一位父亲，两个儿子。小儿子现在就要求分家产——在那时的文化里，等于说「我巴不得你死了」。大儿子留下了，干活，规矩一条没犯。

ENGLISH: This story is not mainly about the son who leaves. Watch the father: what he does once the money is gone is the part that would have shocked Jesus’ first listeners.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 这个故事真正的主角不是出走的儿子，而是父亲。钱花光以后他做了什么，才是当年听众最受不了的地方。

ENGLISH: This is the third of three “lost” parables in Luke 15 — the lost sheep, the lost coin, and the lost son. It is told because the religious crowd was grumbling that Jesus welcomed sinners.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 这是路加福音 15 章三个「失而复得」的故事中的第三个：丢了羊、丢了钱、丢了儿子。耶稣讲这些，是因为宗教人士抱怨他接待罪人。

ENGLISH: Grace is the father running before the apology is finished.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 恩典就是：道歉的话还没说完，父亲已经跑过去抱住了他。

ENGLISH: The father absorbs the cost, restores the ring, and throws a feast — while still going out to plead with the son who never left. He is prodigal, extravagant, with mercy for both.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 父亲为两个儿子都付上了代价：袍子、戒指、鞋、肥牛犊，然后还要走出门去劝那个从没离开过的儿子。对这两个儿子，他都是这样不计代价地爱。

ENGLISH: Which brother are you today — and what would coming home look like?
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 今天的你，更像哪一个儿子？对你来说，「回家」会是什么样子？

ENGLISH: The younger: I need to stop rehearsing and start walking
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 小儿子：别再把台词背下去了，该往回走了

ENGLISH: Repentance in Luke 15 is a journey, not a mood. “He arose and came to his father.” Luke 15:20
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 悔改不是在心里难过一阵就够了，而是要真的站起来，转过身，往家走。「于是起来，往他父亲那里去。」路加福音 15:20

ENGLISH: The elder: I have stayed, but my heart is far away
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 大儿子：我人留下了，心却离得很远

ENGLISH: The father went out to him too. Obedience without love is its own kind of far country. Luke 15:28–31
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 父亲也为大儿子走了出去。人还留在家里，心一样可以走得很远——顺服里没有爱，人也一样会走丢。路加福音 15:28–31

ENGLISH: The bystander: I want to know how to welcome someone
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 旁观者：我想学会怎么接纳一个人

ENGLISH: Then leave the seat empty and the door open. That is how the parable invites us to finish it. Luke 15:32
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 那就把座位留着，把门开着。耶稣讲这个故事，就是想让我们站在这个位置上。路加福音 15:32

ENGLISH: The scroll opens on a warm courtyard: a large house, olive trees, servants moving between the storehouses. Two sons. One father.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 书卷展开在一座温暖的院子里：大宅、橄榄树、仆人在仓库之间来来去去。两个儿子，一位父亲。

SPEAKER: younger
ENGLISH: Father, give me the portion of goods that falleth to me.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「父亲，请你把我应得的家业分给我。」

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: In that culture, this is not a request for an allowance. It is “I wish you were dead, and I want my share now.” The inheritance would normally come at the funeral.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 在那个年代，这句话不是要零花钱，而是「我巴不得你死了，现在就分给我」。产业本来要等到父亲去世才分。

ENGLISH: The father says nothing for a long moment. Then he divides his living between them.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 父亲沉默了很久。然后，他把产业分给了他们。

ENGLISH: Try to talk the younger son out of it
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 试着劝小儿子回心转意

ENGLISH: He will not even look at you. Somebody has promised him a better story somewhere else, and he can already hear its music.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 他连看都没看你。有人已经给他描绘过一个更自在的地方，他连那边的音乐都听见了。

ENGLISH: Ask the father why he agrees to give it
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 问父亲为什么答应他

SPEAKER: father
ENGLISH: “Because love that holds on by force is not love,” he says. “I would rather be wounded and keep my son than keep my property and lose him.”
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「靠扣住家产把人留住，留住的不是爱，只是人，」他说，「我宁可自己受伤，也不要这样。」

ENGLISH: Stand with the servants, who have gone quiet
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 和沉默下来的仆人们站在一起

ENGLISH: They know that a divided estate means some of them will be let go. Nobody in this story is untouched by the son’s choice.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 他们清楚，家一分，有些帮工就得走。这个儿子的决定，牵着每一个人的生计。

ENGLISH: Not many days later, the younger son gathers everything, takes a journey into a far country — and spends it all.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 过了不多几日，小儿子把所有的都收拾起来，往远方去了——就在那里散尽了。

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: Luke uses one devastating phrase: “wasted his substance with riotous living.” No details. We are not invited to enjoy the sin.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 路加用了一句很重的话：「任意放荡，浪费资财。」没有细节。那些罪，没什么好细看的。

ENGLISH: Back home, the father is often on the road, looking toward the horizon.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 而在家里，父亲常常走到路口，望着天边。

SPEAKER: servant
ENGLISH: He goes out there every evening. Every single evening.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「他每天傍晚都出去。每一天。」

ENGLISH: Ask how long the father intends to keep waiting
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 问父亲打算等到什么时候

SPEAKER: servant
ENGLISH: The servant shrugs. “Until he comes back, I suppose.” It has been more than a year.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 仆人耸耸肩：「大概是等到他回来吧。」已经一年多了。

ENGLISH: Go out to the road and wait with him
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 到路上陪他一起等

ENGLISH: You stand beside him in the dust until the light fails. He does not say much. He does not need you to.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你在尘土里站到他旁边，直到天光褪尽。他没说多少话，也不需要你说。

ENGLISH: Follow the younger son into the far country
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 跟着小儿子去远方

ENGLISH: You find a city that is bright at night and expensive in the morning. His friends are already gone when the money runs out.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你找到一座城：夜里灯火通明，白天什么都贵。钱花光以后，他的朋友一个都不见了。

ENGLISH: A mighty famine rises in that land. The son, who once threw money from a table, now hires himself out to a citizen — to feed pigs.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 那地方遇上大饥荒。从前把钱往外撒的儿子，如今去投靠本地一个人——替他放猪。

ENGLISH: He is so hungry that the pods the pigs eat look good to him. And no one gives him anything.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 他饿到觉得猪吃的豆荚都是好东西。可没有人给他。

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: For a Jewish listener, pigs are the bottom. Luke could not have made the fall steeper.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 对当时的犹太听众来说，猪圈已经是最低的地方了——再往下，就没有了。

SPEAKER: younger
ENGLISH: He came to himself.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「他醒悟过来。」

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: Four words. The turning point of the whole parable. He does not get rescued first — he comes to himself.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 四个字。整个比喻在这里拐了个弯。他不是先被救出来——他是先醒过来。

ENGLISH: Remind him that his father’s hired servants have bread
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 提醒他：父亲家里连雇工都有饼吃

SPEAKER: younger
ENGLISH: The thought lands like a physical blow. “Bread,” he says. “Even the servants.” He has not thought of home in months.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 这句话像打了他一拳。「连雇工，」他喃喃地说，「都有饼吃。」他已经好几个月没想起家了。

ENGLISH: Sit in the mud with him until he can speak
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 陪他坐在泥里，等他自己开口

ENGLISH: You say nothing. After a long time he says, “I have to go back.” You nod. He needs to hear himself say it.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你什么也没说。过了很久，他说：「我得回去。」你点点头——他需要听见自己说出口。

ENGLISH: Help him rehearse the words: “Father, I have sinned”
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 陪他把「父亲，我得罪了」练一遍

ENGLISH: He practises it out loud, twice, and then a third time. He is preparing to return as a servant, not a son.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 他大声练了两遍，又练了第三遍。他想好了：回去做雇工，不做儿子。

SPEAKER: younger
ENGLISH: I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before thee, and am no more worthy to be called thy son: make me as one of thy hired servants.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「我要起来，到我父亲那里去，向他说：父亲！我得罪了天，又得罪了你；从今以后，我不配称为你的儿子，把我当作一个雇工吧！」

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: Repentance in this story is not a feeling of regret. It is a direction. He stands up and starts walking — hundreds of miles, in the same sandals he wore into the pigsty.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 这个故事里，悔改不是心里懊悔一下，而是一个方向。他站起来开始走——几百里路，穿的还是走进猪圈时那双鞋。

ENGLISH: The road is long. He gets quieter the closer he gets to home.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 路很长。离家越近，他越说不出话。

ENGLISH: Walk with him as far as the last ridge
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 陪他走到最后一道山脊

ENGLISH: At the top he stops, and you see the roof of the house below. He is crying. You leave him there — the last part is his.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 到了山脊上他停住了。你看见山下那座房子的屋顶。他在哭。你先走开几步——最后这一程，得他自己走。

ENGLISH: Run ahead and warn the household
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 先跑回家去报信

ENGLISH: You burst into the courtyard shouting. The father is already running past you before you finish the sentence.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你冲进院子大喊。话还没说完，父亲已经从你身边跑了出去。

ENGLISH: Ask Corin whether the father will take him back
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 问柯林，父亲会不会收他

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: Corin smiles. “You have read this story before,” he says. “Watch the father’s feet.”
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 柯林笑了：「你从前读过这个故事吧。留意父亲的脚。」

ENGLISH: And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「于是起来，往他父亲那里去。相离还远，他父亲看见他。」

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: He saw him a great way off — because he had been looking. Every evening. For years.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 相离还远就看见了——因为他一直在看。每个傍晚，看了好几年。

ENGLISH: The father runs. In that culture, a patriarch does not run; it is undignified. He does not care. He falls on his son’s neck and kisses him.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 父亲跑过去。在那个文化里，一家之主是不跑的，那很失体面。他不在乎。他搂住他的脖子，连连亲他。

SPEAKER: younger
ENGLISH: Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son —
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「父亲！我得罪了天，又得罪了你；从今以后，我不配称为你的儿子——」

SPEAKER: father
ENGLISH: Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet! And bring hither the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry!
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「快把上好的袍子拿出来给他穿，把戒指戴在他指头上，把鞋穿在他脚上；把那肥牛犊牵来宰了，我们可以吃喝快乐！」

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: He never lets his son finish the sentence. The rehearsed speech about becoming a hired servant is cut off by a party.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 儿子的话没说完。那段排练好的、关于做雇工的讲词，被一场筵席打断了。

ENGLISH: Run alongside the father to meet him
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 跟着父亲一起跑出去迎他

SPEAKER: father
ENGLISH: You arrive out of breath in time to see the ring go onto a hand that is still shaking. “My son was dead, and is alive again,” the father keeps saying.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你气喘吁吁赶到，正看见戒指套上一只还在发抖的手。「我这个儿子是死而复活，」父亲一遍一遍地说。

ENGLISH: Weep at the edge of the crowd
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 站在人群边上哭

ENGLISH: You are not family. You are not a servant. You are nobody in this story. And still you cannot stop crying. That is what grace does to bystanders.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你不是家人，也不是仆人。在这个故事里你谁都不是。可你还是止不住眼泪——站在旁边看见恩典的人，都是这样。

ENGLISH: Fetch the best robe yourself
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 亲自去取那件上好的袍子

ENGLISH: The robe is heavy and smells of cedar. You put it over shoulders that are still covered in pig-sty dust. Nobody seems to mind.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 袍子很沉，有香柏木的味道。你把它披在一副还沾着猪圈尘土的肩上。好像没人在意这些。

ENGLISH: Music. Dancing. Lamps in the courtyard. And then the story turns — because the elder son is out in the field.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 音乐、舞蹈、院子里的灯。然后故事拐了个弯——大儿子还在田里。

SPEAKER: elder
ENGLISH: What do these things mean? Lo, these many years do I serve thee, neither transgressed I at any time thy commandment — and yet thou never gavest me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends! But as soon as this thy son was come, which hath devoured thy living, thou hast killed for him the fatted calf!
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「我服事你这多年，从来没有违背过你的命，你并没有给我一只山羊羔，叫我和朋友一同快乐。」

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: Notice: “this thy son.” He will not say “my brother.” He is not wrong about the facts. He is wrong about the family.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 留意他说的是「你这个儿子」。他不肯说「我的兄弟」。论事实，他没有说错；可论关系，他离得还很远。

ENGLISH: The father goes out and pleads with him. He leaves the party to stand in the dark with the son who stayed.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 父亲出去劝他。他离开筵席，走进黑地里，去陪那个留下来的儿子。

ENGLISH: Go out and listen to the elder brother
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 出去听大儿子把话说完

ENGLISH: You stand in the field with him. He is not angry at the party, really. He is hurt that nobody noticed he never left.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你和他一起站在田里。他真正气的不是筵席，是没有人注意到——他从来没离开过。

ENGLISH: Tell him he is being unfair
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 直接告诉他这不公平

ENGLISH: You say it plainly. He says something sharp back. Later you will wish you had asked a question instead.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你照直说了。他顶了你一句。后来你会希望当时多问一句，而不是先下判断。

ENGLISH: Ask the father why he goes out to both sons
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 问父亲：为什么两个儿子，你都要出去找

SPEAKER: father
ENGLISH: “Because both of them are lost,” he says. “One was lost far away. One is lost three feet from my table.”
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「因为两个都迷了路，」他说，「一个迷在远方，一个迷在离我饭桌三步远的地方。」

SPEAKER: father
ENGLISH: Son, thou art ever with me, and all that I have is thine. It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this thy brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「儿啊，你常和我同在，我一切所有的都是你的；只是你这个兄弟是死而复活、失而又得的，所以我们理当欢喜快乐。」

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: The parable ends there. Jesus never tells us whether the elder brother came inside. That silence is deliberate — because the people He was speaking to were the elder brothers, and the ending was up to them.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 比喻就停在这里。耶稣没有说大儿子最后有没有进屋。这份沉默是故意的——因为当年听他讲道的人，正是那些大儿子。结局得他们自己写。

ENGLISH: You look at the lit doorway. Then you look at the dark field.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你看了看那扇亮着灯的门，又看了看黑下来的田。

ENGLISH: Stand with the elder brother in the dark, and wait
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 站在黑地里，陪大儿子一起等

ENGLISH: You do not push. You just stay. Sometimes that is the only invitation a person can accept.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你没有催促他，也没有急着劝他，只是安静地留在他身边。因为有时候，一个人最需要的，不是有人告诉他该怎么走出来，而是有人愿意陪着他，等他慢慢走出来。

ENGLISH: Remind him gently that he is already inside the family
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 温和地提醒他：他早就在这个家里

ENGLISH: “All that I have is thine,” you repeat. He looks at the house for a long time. It is the truest thing anyone has said to him all day.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 「我一切所有的都是你的，」你把这句话重复了一遍。他望着那幢房子，望了很久。这是他一天里听到的最真实的一句话。

ENGLISH: Go back to the feast and keep his seat empty
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 回到筵席，把他的座位留着

ENGLISH: You set an extra place at the table, just in case. The music goes on. The door stays open.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 你多摆了一副餐具，以防万一。音乐没有停，门也一直开着。

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: Two sons. One runs away, one stays and resents it. The father runs after both.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 两个儿子。一个出走，一个留下却满心怨气。父亲为两个人都跑了出去。

SPEAKER: elias
ENGLISH: Most of us have been the younger son at some point. Quite a lot of us have been the elder one for years and never noticed.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 我们多半在某一段时间里是小儿子；也有不少人做了很多年的大儿子，自己却没察觉。

ENGLISH: The scroll turns, but the music from the courtyard follows you down the road.
CHINESE (rewrite this column, keep the I: 书卷翻页，院子里的音乐却一路跟着你。
